subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI MEMORY.md budget display and save-time guard now, or fold this remaining behavior into the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation, but the remaining request changes workspace-file editing and memory lifecycle behavior rather than repairing one broken code path.

options.title: Define a narrow core UI guardrail
options.body: Add a Control UI budget meter and explicit warning or guarded save path for MEMORY.md while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877, with this issue as the Control UI case once maintainers confirm that direction.

options.title: Declare diagnostics sufficient
options.body: Keep current prompt, doctor, and /context diagnostics as the intended product behavior and close the remaining UI/save-enforcement request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core UI guardrail
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget meter and explicit warning or guarded save path for MEMORY.md while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the central bootstrap truncation warning implementation and are the strongest routing candidate for the product boundary decision.
